blocks.text:
## What to expect on your journey

In the Rincón de la Vieja area, the programme begins with the Mega Combo Tour: hanging bridges, a zip-line, horseback riding, hot springs and a waterfall, all in one day.

The next natural highlight is Río Celeste, the sky-blue river. The route leads through humid forest to Los Teñideros, where the water turns turquoise, and to the Río Celeste waterfall.

The cultural part focuses on the Maleku people. During the visit, you will discover their dances and local crafts: drums, carved gourds, pottery, baskets and tapestries.

At Arenal, the programme returns to nature: hanging bridges in tropical rainforest, views of the volcano and a walk across old lava flows. A boat then crosses Lake Arenal on the way to Monteverde, where a canopy tour above the cloud forest treetops is planned.

The final 2 days are spent on the Pacific coast.
